prompt: Photorealistic full-length studio photograph of one English gentleman of about 45 with a neat moustache and short side-parted hair, in 1912 first-class white-tie evening dress: a black wool tailcoat cut away at the waist with long tails behind, a white pique waistcoat, a white pique bow tie, a stiff wing collar, a starched white dress shirt with studs, black trousers with a silk braid down the outer seam, black patent leather shoes. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, front view, facing the camera, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held a little away from the body, empty open hands, feet slightly apart and fully visible. Plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, no props, no text, no logos. Historically accurate 1912 Edwardian clothing and hair, a natural realistic face, sharp fabric detail.
